body:
Use Rich's `Live` display to repeatedly update terminal output; see the [Live display documentation](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/live.rst). Flushing sends buffered text to the stream; it does not move the cursor or erase the rest of a line. `Live` handles cursor movement and refreshes the display. For usage questions, please ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
